title: FM Synthesis
idiom: 1980s Memphis-design screenprint, two sine ribbons wound together flaring into a bell
hero_prompt: Screenprint in the bold playful manner of 1980s Memphis design, flat pastel pink, mint and pale yellow with heavy black line, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: from the left edge two smooth wavy ribbons run side by side, one thick and slow with a few wide waves, one thin and quick with many tight waves; toward the middle the thin ribbon winds tightly around the thick one like a vine around a pole, and on the right the wound pair flares open into one large bronze hand-bell standing on its rim, short curved ring lines spreading from its mouth. Behind, a loose scatter of small black dots, triangles and squiggles on the pastel ground. Lots of open space.
icon_prompt: Screenprint emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a pastel pink ground, no shading or gradients: a bold hand-bell whose handle is one thick wavy line rising from its top, with two short curved ring lines beside its mouth. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
